privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Global Beyond LLC
privacy.metaDescription: How Global Beyond LLC collects, uses, and protects the information submitted through this website.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the information Global Beyond LLC (“the company”) collects through globalbeyondllc.com and how it uses it.

p: The company collects the information the user voluntarily submits through the site's forms: name, email address, phone number and the content of the message or review.

The site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. It uses aggregate visit and performance measurements provided by Vercel, which work without cookies and without identifying the user. The browser stores locally a technical flag for the chosen language; it contains no personal data and is not sent to the company.
The company uses the information to read and answer the message or review received and to keep a record of the communication. It does not use it for advertising. It does not sell or rent it.
Messages are delivered by email through Resend, and the site is hosted on Vercel. These providers process the information to provide their service, under their own terms and policies.
Links to WhatsApp and Instagram, Meta services, are governed by the policies of those services. The company does not control how they handle data.
The company may disclose information when required by law or by a competent authority.
The company keeps the information for as long as needed to answer the communication, keep records and meet legal obligations.

The user may request access to, correction of or deletion of their information by writing through the contact form or on WhatsApp. The company will handle the request in accordance with applicable law.
The company applies reasonable measures to protect the information. No method of transmission or storage over the internet is completely secure.
The site is not directed to children under 13 and the company does not knowingly collect their information.
The company may update this policy. The update date shows the latest revision.
Questions about this policy are sent through the contact form or on WhatsApp.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of globalbeyondllc.com, operated by Global Beyond LLC, a limited liability company registered in the State of Florida, United States. By using the site, the user accepts these terms. If the user does not agree, they must stop using the site.

p: This site presents information about Global Beyond LLC and allows inquiries and requests to be sent. It is not a store: no purchases or payments are made on the site.

The company sells its products through third-party e-commerce platforms. Sales, payments, shipping, returns and after-sales service are governed by the rules of the platform where the purchase is made.

The information on the site, including products, descriptions, prices and availability, is for reference and may change without notice. It is not an offer, a quote or a contract. It may contain errors or omissions.

Product names and brands belong to their respective owners. Their mention on the site does not imply affiliation, sponsorship or authorization by those owners. Descriptions do not replace the manufacturer's information. Personal care products do not replace the guidance of a health professional.
The user agrees not to disrupt the site, not to extract its content in bulk, not to submit false or malicious information and not to use it to distribute illegal content.

The name Global Beyond LLC, the logo, and the text, photographs and design of the site belong to Global Beyond LLC or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced for the user's own purposes without prior written authorization.

By submitting a review or a message, the user declares that the content is truthful and their own, and that it does not infringe third-party rights. The user authorizes the company to use it to respond and, for reviews, to publish it. The company may decline to publish or remove any content.

The site links to WhatsApp and Instagram, Meta services, and to email. When leaving the site through those links, the terms of each service apply. The company does not control and is not responsible for their content or practices.
The site and its content are provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the extent permitted by law.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Global Beyond LLC and its members are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages arising from the use of the site or the inability to use it, or for transactions made on third-party platforms. These terms do not exclude liability that the law does not allow to be excluded.
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, United States. Any dispute will be submitted to the state or federal courts located in Miami-Dade County, Florida.
